label: Sync Gateway instance
type: a single running Sync Gateway process, typically deployed on a dedicated node/tier separate from Couchbase Server, using lightweight threads and async I/O ("designed for multiprocessing"). Serves the public REST API on port 4984 by default. A load balancer distributes requests across multiple instances; a reverse proxy can additionally terminate TLS for them.
note: Distinct from tool:sync-gateway (the shipped binary/software itself) - this concept is a specific deployed, running process.
